integrity: The sharp four-regime tail asymptotics are proved analytically and numerically checked. Cone metric, diameter, and squared distance moments are credited as background rather than claimed new. Worldwide historical priority is not certified; independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-shape finite right circular lateral cones with intrinsically uniform area sampling, plus the flat-disk limit; no uniform double-scaling result at either shape transition; excludes chord distance, solid cone, base disk, weighted measures, frusta.
title: Sharp upper-distance tails at the tip–rim transition of a finite flat cone
